organizations.publicNote: German recording company active from 1925 to 1972; the linked discs use Electrola as their imprint. In 1972 Electrola-Gesellschaft and Carl Lindström GmbH were merged into the successor company EMI Electrola. The designation E.G. belongs to a record series, not to the organization’s name.

sources.fullCitation: Jack Hylton und sein Orchester, refrain sung by Siegfried Arno. “Das verliebte Orchester.” Fox-trot; label credits text and music to Fritz Rotter and Dr. B. Kaper. Electrola E.G. 2259, matrix 60-1496, n.d. Shellac disc, Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv; filmed-label transfer on YouTube. Accessed 20 August 2026.
